BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BARCH   SEMESTER: VII/ADD
BRANCH: ARCHITECTURE   SESSION : MO/2019

                                    SUBJECT : AR7303 HOUSING AND SETTLEMENT SYSTEM

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Define census house. Differentiate between house and housing. [2]
 (b) Discuss the current housing scenario of India with special reference to urban and rural
perspective.
[3]


Q2 (a) Outline  the criteria of spatial quality which assure a  positive impact in urban  housing
projects.
[2]
 (b) Classify various housing typology based on certain chosen aspects. [3]


Q3 (a) What are the advantages of Housing Cooperatives? [2]
 (b) Outline  the  significant  changes  in  approach  of  public  housing/social  housing  in  India
together with reference to the global scenario during 1990’s.
[3]


Q4 (a) Define and differentiate between ‘housing need’ and ‘housing demand’. [2]
 (b) Housing market is a function of demography, economy and factor related to governance.
Discuss.
[3]


Q5 (a) Outline the Constraint in real estate development. [2]
 (b) Compare the general characteristics of three types of slums, a] Squatter Settlements,
b] Urban blight at City core, c] Unauthorised Settlements [urban sprawl].
[3]


Q6 (a) Discuss how slums are defined. Why universal definition of slum has not been evolved? [2]
 (b) Discuss some of the design & planning issues related to Generic needs of slum residents
that  you  would  consider  for  different  aspects  of  housing  together  with  possible  /
preferred solutions.
[3]

BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BARCH   SEMESTER: VII
BRANCH: ARCH   SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : AR7303 HOUSING AND SETTLEMENT SYSTEMS

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Define Institutional Household and Communal Establishments. [2]
 (b) How can you relate housing as an index of social welfare and quality of life? [3]


Q2 (a) What are the advantages of Housing Cooperatives? [2]
 (b) What is special purpose housing? Discuss the need and characteristics of various special
purpose housing.
[3]


Q3 (a) How will you assess quantitative and qualitative housing shortage for an urban
settlement?
[2]
 (b) Discuss the factors that affect housing market. [3]


Q4 (a) Mention the institutions from where the need for long term finance for housing in the
country is being met.
[2]
 (b) Differentiate between housing need and housing demand. [3]


Q5 (a) Point out and explain the various causes of growth of slums in big urban settlements. [2]
 (b) Discuss how slums are defined. Why norms for declaring a housing locality a ‘slum’ may
differ from place to place? Why universal definition of slum has not been evolved?
[3]


Q6 (a) List different well-known approaches for slum improvement and point out the reasons for
changes in approach to slum improvement.
[2]
 (b) Compare the general characteristics of three types of slums, a] Squatter Settlements, b]
Urban blight at City core, c] Unauthorised Settlements [urban sprawl].
[3]
